# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and glyph replay fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 servicing work improves path bounds, clipping, and validation of serialized glyph replay data. These collected m156 updates leave managed wrappers, generated bindings, and package versions unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Correct path and clip bounds** — Upstream fixes correct Ganesh device-space path bounds and software coverage-mask subset clamping, plus Graphite clip-key packing and wedge miter bounds. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617))
- **Validate serialized glyph replay** — Slug replay validates positions, matrices, bounds, and flags, bounds direct-mask offsets, and preserves creation-time float rounding. Unsuitable glyph data retains rendering fallbacks, including when glyph-atlas bilinear filtering is unavailable. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624))
